messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — kb sweep found a redirect hiccup that's blocking the onboarding sprint preview. /kb/runtime/compat -> /kb/runtime/compatibility -> back to /kb/runtime/compat and ends 404. Seen while loading the model-onboarding guide.

docs-bot: automated link-scan: 1 redirect chain (2 hops) detected for /kb/runtime/compat, severity: medium. Rule: canonical-redirect-loop. See: https://internal.ops/link-scan/3669876543

jonathan: is that only in prod or do we see it on staging too?

maria: repros in prod and staging. quick curl shows the hops:

```
$ curl -I https://docs.redwood.ai/kb/runtime/compat
HTTP/1.1 302 Found
Location: /kb/runtime/compatibility
HTTP/1.1 302 Found
Location: /kb/runtime/compat
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
```

kevin: I'll take it. do we want a 301 from /kb/runtime/compat -> /kb/runtime/compatibility (canonical) or restore the old slug?

maria: prefer a 301 to canonical /kb/runtime/compatibility so permalinks don't rot. small frontmatter redirect is fine if it's faster.

kevin: ok creating a tiny PR. plan: add frontmatter `redirect_from: ["/kb/runtime/compat"]` on the compatibility doc and add a lint exception for the checks.

sasha: can you also ripgrep for other variants while you're at it? command: `rg "runtime/compat|runtime/compatibility" -n docs/` — better to catch any inline links.

kevin: good call, running that now. found 3 references inside docs/examples/ and one in docs/handbook/. will include fixes in the same PR.

kevin: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12345 — includes frontmatter redirect + two sed fixes for inline links + unit test update. notes in PR.

docs-bot: deploy-preview: preview available at https://deploy-preview-12345--docs.redwood.ai — link-checks passed, integration preview shows 301 -> canonical.

maria: awesome, assigning to @kevin and marking as P2 for the sprint board. thx :thumbsup:

jonathan: nice, please add the incident tag to the PR so we can track on the board.

kevin: done. merging after one more LGTM.

maria: if merge goes smoothly we'll cherry-pick to the last release branch. ping here once merged and deployed so i can unblock the onboarding preview.

kevin: will do.

(reacts: maria :eyes:)
